# General information

## Acknowledgement of Country

We acknowledge the Ngunnawal and Ngambri-Kamberri peoples, the Traditional
Custodians of the lands on which the ANU Acton campus stands and on which we
meet today. We pay our respects to their Elders past and present, and to all
Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples.

## Registration

Register at Room 6.02, [Marie Reay Teaching
Centre](https://maps.app.goo.gl/GrTQ6SBZfmydb6HM8), Australian National
University, Canberra, from 11 am on Monday 30 November.

## Wi-Fi

There will be free Wi-Fi at the venue. The password is **APSRC2026!**
